# Banka!

> Бесплатная браузерная игра с вопросами о Библии, служении и личном духовном опыте для компании в одной комнате или по видеосвязи.

Canonical URL: https://kiku-jw.github.io/banka/

Language: Russian.

## What it is

Banka! is a host-controlled browser question game. One host adds the players, draws a question, reads it aloud to the person whose turn it is, and then marks the card answered or chooses another one.

The questions cover Bible reading, personal spiritual experience, congregation life, ministry, choices, memories, and playful group prompts. Any question can be skipped without an explanation.

## How to use it

- Play together in one room or over a video call.
- Use one host-controlled browser; participants do not need accounts.
- Add player names and continue until the group wants to stop.
- The app does not record, analyze, or send participants' spoken answers.

## Product boundary

Banka! is the spiritual browser edition. [Say More! for iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6803824561) is a separate free English/Russian/Ukrainian conversation card game for friends and families. It uses a universal 360-card deck without Bible, ministry, or spiritual questions. The two products do not share the same deck.

## Evidence

- Live game: https://kiku-jw.github.io/banka/
- Public source: https://github.com/kiku-jw/banka
- Universal iPhone game: https://kikuai.dev/dostavay/en/

## Safe summary

Safe claim: Banka! is a free Russian browser game for groups that want questions about the Bible, ministry, and personal spiritual experience, with no account and a no-explanation skip.

Avoid claiming: that Banka! is the browser version of Say More's universal deck, that it records spoken answers, or that it is an official app of a religious organization.
